assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Field to track when this facility was last updated in the asset hierarchy

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

adminGroups.description:
Default authorized {@link Role}s.
Users having any of these roles can update the [AclEntries](AclEntry) for any facility.
These users' access controls to the facility are determined by seeded {@link AclPrivilege} for {@link Facility}.

additionalGroups.description:
Additional {@link Role}s.
Only {@link User}s belonging to these roles are considered as additional users in the UI.

users.description:
Any additional {@link User}s apart from users belonging to {@link FacilityAccessManager#adminGroups} that have access to a facility.
These users' access controls to the facility are determined by seeded {@link AclPrivilege} for {@link Facility}.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

trackingIdForImport.description: This ID is used to determine which import this entity belongs to.

weatherStation.description: The weather station associated with the location of the asset.

memberIntersections.description: References to MemberToEntity that map to this instance.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

locationHistory.description: The historical location/address for the asset.

location.description: The current location/address for this asset.

realTimeLocations.description: Real-time location data for a moving asset.

parentRelations.description: The relations to the parent facilies of a given facility.

childRelations.description: The relations to the children facilies of a given facility.

denormAncestors.description: Ancestors in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

denormDescendants.description: Descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

relativePositionHistory.description: The historical relative positions of this physical asset.

relativePosition.description: The current relative position of this physical asset.

measurements.description: Physical measurement series related to this asset.

pointMeasurements.description: Point measurement series for time-series metrics related to the asset.

events.description: The event history for this physical asset.

childSensorRelations.description:
The {@link Sensor}s associated with this {@link PhysicalAsset}.

This field establishes the relationship between the physical asset and its associated sensors,
using a filter to only include sensors in the relation (where the type of relation is 'SENSOR').

diagramRelations.description: Relations to {@link ParsableDiagram}s which have been linked to this asset.

numDiagramRelations.description: Count of {@link ParsableDiagram}s which have been linked to this asset.

timeToEventPredictions.description: The active {@link TimeToEventPrediction} objects directly belonging to this asset

eventCategoryRelations.description: The relations to {@link EventCategory} this asset has

placedAt.description:
The location of the asset. Certain assets can be moved from one place to another, such as electrical meters,
but currently, placedAt is just one location fixed across all of time.

parent.description: Gets the direct parent associated with this {@link Facility}.

children.description: The assets directly included by this one

denormParents.description: Records representing all ancestors in the asset hierarchy

denormChildren.description: Records representing all descendants in the asset hierarchy

assetOwners.description: All fixed asset owners for this asset.

orgs.description: All organizations that are owners of this fixed asset.

partyRelations.description: All relationships in the party role hierarchy.

partyRoles.description: The specific party roles attached via AssetPartyRole.

regions.description:
These commented out pending:PLAT-3387

The business region this asset belongs to

businessRegion    : BusinessRegion

The geo-political region this asset belongs to

geoPoliticalRegion    : GeoPoliticalRegion

Regions directly linked to this asset

stored calc "businessRegion + geoPoliticalRegion + utilityRateRegion"

regionParents.description: Regions linked to this asset or its ancestor assets

allRegionParents.description: Regions linked to this asset or its ancestor asset and all their parent regions

geometry.description:
Geometry component of {@link Location#address placedAt.address}.

@see LatLong

address1.description: Street address component of {@link Location#address placedAt.address}.

city.description: Name of locality (city/town) component of {@link Location#address placedAt.address}.

state.description: Abbreviation of State/Province/administrative_area component of {@link Location#address placedAt.address}.

postal_code.description: Postal or zip code component of {@link Location#address placedAt.address}.

facilityType.description: Utility defined building type of facility such as APT, RES, MARINA, B&B, AUTOGAS etc.

characteristics.description:
Facility characteristics with historical values.

@see FacilityCharacteristicSet

displayHierarchyStatus.description: This field is used by the UI to show the translated value of {@link hierarchyStatus}.

hierarchyStatus.description: This field indicates the current status of the asset hierarchy setup.

isHierarchyComplete.description: This field indicates whether the asset hierarchy setup has been completed for this facility.

title: Represents a facility in a potential hierarchy (denormalized) of facilities
name: Facility
